name: HERO Anti-OverDefense
tagline: A paste-in contract that stops coding agents from over-defending
description: HERO Anti-OverDefense is a paste-in contract that stops coding agents from over-defending their work. It distills the guardrails into four pillars — Hashing, Edge cases, Rubrics, and Overbuild — giving agents clear boundaries on when to stop and how far to go. It works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents, making it a lightweight but surprisingly effective addition to any agentic workflow.
highlights: A paste-in contract built on Hashing, Edge cases, Rubrics, and Overbuild
Stops coding agents from over-defending and over-engineering
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents
Lightweight guardrail you drop straight into a prompt
curatorNote: Anyone who has watched an agent gold-plate a simple task will feel this one. HERO distills exactly how to tell agents when enough is enough — a small file with outsized practical value.
